KeysToEntries.Quest.Name: The Great Body Robbery
KeysToEntries.Quest.Description: Assist Dr Fenkenstrain in acquiring a new body. FOR SCIENCE!
KeysToEntries.Doctor.NotSpokenTo.Intro.1: They called me mad. MAD! Me, the greatest genius of the age! But I'll show them! I'll show them all!
KeysToEntries.Doctor.NotSpokenTo.Intro.2: Bwahahahahahahahahaha...ahem... oh... hello. Who might you be then?
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.IdLikeToAskYouFirst: I'd like to ask you first...
KeysToEntries.Doctor.NotSpokenTo.Intro.3: I don't really care. I only asked out of habit. Still, now that you're here, perhaps you can do something for me?
KeysToEntries.Doctor.NotSpokenTo.Intro.4: I need you to collect a few things. Nothing too strenuous, just some arms, legs, that sort of stuff. You can easily dig them up from graves around the Bloodblight Swamps, hardly an inconvenience really. Well? Science waits for no one! Go! GET!
KeysToEntries.Objective.DigUpBodyParts.0: Dig up body parts from graves around the Bloodblight Swamps. 0/3
KeysToEntries.Objective.DigUpBodyParts.1: Dig up body parts from graves around the Bloodblight Swamps. 1/3
KeysToEntries.Objective.DigUpBodyParts.2: Dig up body parts from graves around the Bloodblight Swamps. 2/3
KeysToEntries.Fenkenstrain.Name: Doctor Fenkenstrain
KeysToEntries.Doctor.SpokenTo.AcceptedQuest.1: I need you to collect a few things. Nothing too strenuous, just some arms, legs, that sort of stuff. You can easily dig them up around the Bloodblight Swamps, hardly an inconvenience really.
KeysToEntries.Doctor.SpokenTo.AcceptedQuest.2: Look around big scary trees, that's where people normally seem to want to bury their dead around here.
KeysToEntries.Doctor.SpokenTo.AcceptedQuest.3: Some might call what we're doing ghoulish, but I prefer the term recycling. Reduce, reuse, recycle for a better future and all that.
KeysToEntries.Doctor.OptionDialogue.Intro: Bwahahahahaha! Oh, hrmm? What do you want?
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.OptionalDialogue.IsntThereA: Isn't there a Dr Fenkenstrain on the mainland?
KeysToEntries.Doctor.Optional.WhoAreYou.1: Me? I was once-- no, I still am-- the most ingenius inventor of this and all other ages!
KeysToEntries.Doctor.Optional.WhoAreYou.3: In my youth I offered solutions to the problems of Ashenfall with my wonderous inventions. They spurned my genius, then, all because of a few fires and a handful of bloody dismemberments.
KeysToEntries.Doctor.Optional.WhoAreYou.4: Tragedies, yes, but tragedies that opened my eyes to my true destiny and the research that would consume my every waking moment..
KeysToEntries.Doctor.Optional.WhoAreYou.5: Death? HA! A minor inconvenience! One I sought to overcome and overcome it I did! All it took was lightning, various chemicals and being shunned by everyone around me!
KeysToEntries.Doctor.Optional.WhoAreYou.6: Yet here I am, and here they aren't! I was right! I win! I am the greatest genius in Ashenfall! AHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!
KeysToEntries.Doctor.Optional.RestOfYou.1: That is a very personal question, and we are not yet well acquainted enough for you to learn the answer.
KeysToEntries.Doctor.Optional.RestOfYou.2: Just know that when I find that accursed chicken again, it shall rue the day. RUE THE VERY DAY!
KeysToEntries.Doctor.Optional.OtherFenkenstrain.1: Ah, the bloodline persists does it? But of course it must, great great grandmummy was ever so popular around the town.
KeysToEntries.Doctor.Optional.OtherFenkenstrain.2: She made all her husbands carry her surname, don't you know.
KeysToEntries.Doctor.Optional.OtherFenkenstrain.3: Tragically they all died of natural causes... entirely natural, indeed.
KeysToEntries.Doctor.GotBodyParts.Intro.1: An unusual collection of body parts. I don't suppose you could have found something in a size nine?
KeysToEntries.Doctor.GotBodyParts.Intro.2: Still, no matter, science demands sacrifice and the parts are at least fresh enough to work with... surprisingly well preserved in some cases...
KeysToEntries.Doctor.GotBodyParts.Intro.3: Best not to dwell, I'm sure there's a lorebook somewhere to explain the lack of decay or something. There's always an excuse.
KeysToEntries.Doctor.GotBodyParts.Intro.4: Now, stick the parts on the examination table will you? Then we can really have some fun.
KeysToEntries.Objective.PlacePartsOnTable: Place the body parts on the examination table in Fenkenstrain's tower.
KeysToEntries.Table.NoParts: A medical table, with straps to keep a body in place. You choose not to dwell on why someone might just have this lying around.
KeysToEntries.Table.NotEnoughParts: If you tried to place the body parts you have right now, onto the table, they'd all just fall through the restraints in a gruesome tumble. You'll need a full set to secure everything in place and avoid lengthy psychiatry bills.
KeysToEntries.Table.AddingOnParts: You connect the body parts together like some terrible jigsaw puzzle. Your mother would be so proud.
KeysToEntries.Doctor.Table.AutopsyInstruction.1: Excellent. Excellent! A somewhat motley collection of components, but we can work with it.
KeysToEntries.Doctor.Table.AutopsyInstruction.2: Now, take a look at each of the components, let's make sure they're in good nick. Can't be working with substandard tools, now can we!
KeysToEntries.Table.ExamineTorso.1: The torso is muscular and well-preserved, perhaps the remains of a skilled warrior.
KeysToEntries.Table.ExamineTorso.2: Thin greenish veins run through the torso that generate an acrid smell. The signs of some sort of toxic corruption of the flesh.
KeysToEntries.Table.ExamineArms.1: A pair of powerful garou arms. They are fresher than you like to admit, perhaps only a few days old.
KeysToEntries.Table.ExamineArms.2: Some of the muscles have deteriorated a little, as if the previous owner wasn't a focused fighter. Unusual for a garou.
KeysToEntries.Table.ExamineLegs.1: Goblin legs, in a surprisingly good state. Goblin legs may look bandy and spindly, but they're surprisingly strong and would make a good foundation for this... creation.
KeysToEntries.Table.ExamineLegs.2: There are some small cuts and bruises across the legs, indication of some minor damaged sustained before the significantly more major damage that allowed you to find these legs in the first place.
KeysToEntries.Doctor.ExaminedAllLimbs.1: Interesting. Poison damage, a lack of arm strength and some superficial damage to the legs indicating poor survival skills. All of these are problems that can be easily resolved...
KeysToEntries.Doctor.ExaminedAllLimbs.3: Some simple potions will suffice. You'll need a weak antipoison for the veins, a weak lumberjack potion for the muscles and a weak focused attack potion for the superficial damage.
KeysToEntries.Doctor.ExaminedAllLimbs.4: If you can bring me these, then we can continue with our research and shatter the languid assumptions of layman SCIENCE!
KeysToEntries.Objective.BringPotions: Bring Dr Fenkenstrain: 1 Weak Antipoison, 1 Weak Focused Attack Potion and 1 Weak Lumberjack Potion.
KeysToEntries.Doctor.HasPotions.1: Ah good, you've brought the potions. Wonderful! Now if you would just use them on the Examination Table.
KeysToEntries.Doctor.RefuseUsePotions.1: Fool! Without those potions, the body cannot function. Science will be wasted and you will singlehandedly ruin one of the greatest scientific breakthroughs ever known! Come back when you've changed your mind and are ready to rewrite the rules of reality!
KeysToEntries.Doctor.UsePotions.1: You administer the potions. The veins clear up and the muscles look stronger. The cuts and bruises vanish before your eyes, but nothing else seems to happ...
KeysToEntries.Doctor.UsePotions.2: There! It moved! A twitch, subtle and slight, but definite movement.
KeysToEntries.Doctor.UsePotions.3: Not enough though, hrmm... AHA! I know what we need!
KeysToEntries.Doctor.UsePotions.5: Here, take this! It may look like an ordinary bottle, but this has been carefully en-scienced to contain pure lightning -- don't ask about how it works, your tiny mind would buckle under the weight of such knowledge.
KeysToEntries.Doctor.UsePotions.6: Now, all you need to do, is get struck by lightning whilst holding this. You'll be fine, don't grumble. Get shocked, then bring it back here and we shall continue our experiment!
KeysToEntries.Objective.GetLightning: Collect lightning in a bottle and bring it to Dr Fenkenstrain.
KeysToEntries.Doctor.NoLightning.1: Now, all you need to do, is get struck by lightning whilst holding that bottle I gave you. You'll be fine, don't grumble. Get shocked, then bring it back here and we shall continue our experiment!
KeysToEntries.Doctor.GotLightning.1: Ah, you have it! Not going to lie, there was a good chance that wasn't going to work and you'd be obliterated. Fortunately, that is not the case!
KeysToEntries.Doctor.GotLightning.2: Now we move into the final phase! Igor... err, I mean... what's your name again? Doesn't matter, attach my head to my new body! We shall make SCIENTIFIC HISTORY!
KeysToEntries.Pylon.NoLightning: A strange pylon, looks like there's a slot for something.
KeysToEntries.Pylon.HasLightning.1: You install the lightning into the pylon, it hums with power.
KeysToEntries.Pylon.HasLightning.2: Excellent. EXCELLENT! Do you feel it? The power? That hum of possibility as we prepare to destroy death itself! BWAHAHAHAHAA MAD THEY CALLED ME! MAD!
KeysToEntries.Pylon.HasLightning.3: I shall live again! You have served me well Not-Igor, I shall be sure to add your name to my research paper as a noted contributor. On the last page of course.
KeysToEntries.Table.AttachHead.1: You attach the head to the body as best you can, it's much looser than you're comfortable with.
KeysToEntries.Table.AttachHead.3: It is not a perfect fit.
KeysToEntries.Table.AttachHead.InventorySpace.1: Now, leave me be if you don't mind. It's going to take me a little time to learn the ins and outs of my new body.
KeysToEntries.Table.AttachHead.InventorySpace.2: Feel free to drop by another time, and we can consider our next great breakthrough!
KeysToEntries.Table.AttachHead.NoInventorySpace.1: Oh.You appear to be overloaded from your own scientific experiments. It's easy to get carried away. Return to me when you have some space free.
KeysToEntries.Table.AttachHead.4: All that we need now, is that spark of the divine power of creation - lightning! Add the bottled lightning to the pylon, so I may stride this world again as the genius to end all geniuses...geniei?...SCIENTISTS!
KeysToEntries.Doctor.PlacedPartsOnTable.1: No, no, no, don't talk to me. Examine the body! Check it for wounds, damage, glittering coins, that sort of thing. I need you to get your hands dirty because I have no hands available!
KeysToEntries.Table.Autopsy.Link: What would you like to examine?
KeysToEntries.Objective.Autopsy: Perform an autopsy of the body on the examination table in Doctor Fenkenstrain's tower.
KeysToEntries.Table.NoCurrentActions: Best leave this alone for the moment.
KeysToEntries.Objective.PutHeadOnBody: Put Doctor Fenkenstrain's head on his new body on the examination table.
KeysToEntries.Objective.Pylon: Put the Lightning-in-a-bottle into the machine in Doctor Fenkenstrain's lab.
KeysToEntries.ShockedMessage: Shockingly, you are able to capture the lightning in a bottle. You allow yourself to indulge in a single electricity based pun, and note that you should return to Doctor Fenkenstrain sooner rather than later.
KeysToEntries.Coffin.WrongPoint: Graverobbing is a terrible hobby best left to necromancers and mad scientists.
KeysToEntries.Coffin.Torso: A human torso! Just what you've always wanted.
KeysToEntries.Coffin.Legs: You uncover a surprisingly well preserved pair of goblin legs. The toes are still twitching.
KeysToEntries.Coffin.Arms: A sturdy pair of well-preserved garou arms. Perfect for sinister science experiments.
KeysToEntries.Torso.Name: Human torso
KeysToEntries.Torso.Description: A surprisingly well-preserved human torso, must be ancient. Doctor Fenkenstrain is looking for something just like it.
KeysToEntries.Arms.Name: Garou Arms
KeysToEntries.Arms.Description: A pair of well-preserved garou arms, the perfect gift for any mad scientist.
KeysToEntries.Legs.Name: Goblin Legs
KeysToEntries.Legs.Description: A pair of worryingly fresh goblin legs. Doctor Fenkenstrain will be interested in these.
KeysToEntries.Pylon.NeedLightning: You need lightning-in-a-bottle to power this machine.
KeysToEntries.Lightning.Name: Lightning-in-a-bottle
KeysToEntries.Lightning.Description: A lightning bolt trapped in glass. It's best not to think too hard about the physics of it.
KeysToEntries.FenkenstrainHead.Name: Doctor Fenkenstrain's Head
KeysToEntries.FenkenstrainHead.Description: The head of a mad scientist. He would very much appreciate being put on his new body.
KeysToEntries.Doctor.Postquest: Bwahahahahahaha! I'm getting the hang of this. Although my neck feels a bit loose... nah, I'm sure it's fine.
KeysToEntries.Doctor.GenericGreeting: Mad? MAD! Me? The greatest genius of the age? Ha, fools!
KeysToEntries.Doctor.AutopsyEncourage: Now now, don't be squeamish, go give that body a poke would you? See what needs fixing with it.
KeysToEntries.EmptyVial.Name: Empty Vial
KeysToEntries.EmptyVial.Description: Apparently this will collect lightning if you get struck by it.
KeysToEntries.Chicken.Name: Chicken
KeysToEntries.Table.Name: Examination Table
KeysToEntries.Coffin.Name: Coffin
KeysToEntries.Pylon.Name: Strange Machine
KeysToEntries.Key.Description: I wonder what it opens. It's Fenkenstrain's chest, just to be clear.
KeysToEntries.Key.Name: Key
